events.text: DMCI Power Corp., the off-grid energy arm of DMCI Holdings, plans ₱2.4-billion spending to boost off-grid supply, nearly doubling its capital spending this year as it accelerates a mix of renewable and conventional energy projects in missionary areas.
In 2024, DMCI's Integrated Management System completed its 2nd Recertification to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 Standards under Certification International Philippines.
